title: fix: add curated request bodies for responses and integrations docs examples
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
The Docs / Regenerate API reference workflow has failed since #14449 and the Connect App route went live (https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/actions/runs/33920656829). Validation rejects the regenerated file because two POST examples have no body, so no docs PR is created.

- Adds `postV1Responses` and `postAccountIntegrations` to `CURATED_BODIES` in `gen.pollinations.ai/scripts/generate-apidocs.ts`
- `pickExample` cannot synthesize plain `string` fields, and both schemas' only required field is one (`input` string|array, `toolkit` string); compact mode also skips the optional `model` default
- Values mirror existing usage: `openai` advertises `/v1/responses`; `github` is the toolkit slug the integrations tests use
- Verified locally: `docs:generate` then `docs:validate` passes; `APIDOCS.md` is intentionally not included, the workflow regenerates it after merge

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The examples have bodies
gist.blurb: Two API examples were arriving at the docs party empty-handed. The generator now gives Responses and Integrations their proper request bodies, so the reference can keep blooming.
gist.summary: Added curated request bodies for the POST /v1/responses and account integrations API reference examples, allowing the Docs / Regenerate API reference workflow to validate and publish regenerated documentation again.
gist.impact: Developers will get usable generated examples with `input` values for Responses and the `github` toolkit slug for Integrations instead of body-less POST requests blocking documentation updates.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy API-reference garden where Polli repairs two empty pixel request envelopes by placing an `input` card into the Responses envelope and a `github` toolkit tag into the Integrations envelope. A cheerful CRT monitor robot watches a documentation printer produce a clean page, with code-plants and flowers showing that the docs pipeline is growing again.
